According to Semafor, the National Sheriffs’ Association is changing its position on the CLARITY Act from opposition to neutral after months of warning that the bill could make it harder to prosecute illicit finance. Trezor Shipping Provider Breach Expands, Exposing Data of 67,000 More U.S. Customers

Hardware wallet maker Trezor said the data breach at its shipping provider ShipMonk has expanded to affect another 67,000 U.S. customers, who placed orders between November 2019 and August 2021. Exposed data included names, email addresses, phone numbers, shipping addresses and order numbers. Trezor said ShipMonk had repeatedly confirmed the data had been deleted, but it remained in its systems. Trezor’s own systems were not compromised, and users’ devices remain secure. — link
